sloka: तच्छ्रुत्वा शोकसम्तप्ता सम्तापयसि माम् भृशम् ।आविष्टासि गृहम् शून्यम् सा त्वम् परवशम् गता ॥२-१२-१८॥
transliteration: tacchrutvā śokasamtaptā samtāpayasi mām bhṛśam ।āviṣṭāsi gṛham śūnyam sā tvam paravaśam gatā ॥2-12-18॥

translations.english: Further you are tormented with sorrow under the influence of others' insinuations. You are causing me great pain by entering the empty chamber of wrath.
